message: Command `cd /tmp && timeout 60 curl -sL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng/master/src/libespeak-ng/readclause.c" -o current_readclause.c 2>&1; echo "exit: $?"; grep -n "xml_buf\|n_xml_buf\|ProcessSsmlTag\|c1 != '>'" current_readclause.c | head -30` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
The current version still has the `pw[-1]` access and the `while (*pw == name[ix])` loop. So the fix isn't in `GetSsmlAttribute` itself. The fix must be elsewhere - likely in how the tag is read into `xml_buf` in readclause.c, or in how `ProcessSsmlTag` handles the tag.

Let me compare the current readclause.c with the vulnerable one to find the fix.
